title: Monochromatic Portrait with Glitch Effect
coreRelationships: The subject's face is rendered in high-contrast black and white, with deep shadows.
A red 'glitch' or chromatic aberration effect is applied to the edges and some internal areas of the black and white rendering.
The background is solid white, providing a stark contrast to the dark portrait.
The typography is placed in the lower left quadrant, aligned left, and uses a mix of black and red text.
reuseFormula: Generate a high-contrast, black and white portrait with red glitch effects on a white background. Overlay bold, geometric sans-serif typography in black and red in the lower left.
